$comment: VARS category weights. 'active' selects which named vector the evaluator uses unless --weights-set overrides it on the command line. Categories must sum to 1.0. See docs/05-evaluation-and-metrics.md §3 and docs/11-decisions-and-open-questions.md ADR-13.

frozen.$comment: Frozen 2026-08-30 by ADR-13, before any scored run. Not revisited afterward.

rejected_balanced.$comment: The original ADR-2 proposal, superseded by ADR-13. Kept so every VARS figure can also be reported under it (ADR-13 obligation #2).

rejected_flat.$comment: Equal weighting across all five categories, rejected by ADR-13. Kept for the same reason as rejected_balanced.
